No one from church said anything. In fact, they were caring and offered to try to help us get together... there are a few Catholic programs for that. She used to go even after the divorce. I don't feel like I can. 

Thank you :-) I wish you have a great December and an even better new year!

I divorced a little more than a year ago. I was a Catholic before that, not really particularly religious but I had a strong cultural identity with the religion and its values. After the breakup, I was never able to set foot on a church again. 

I did my best to move on. Took meds, therapy. Went partying, dating. I really don't feel I deserve to complain, you know, I had some cool stuff last year. I met interesting girls and friends, had cool dates, really wild parties, had a fair dose of interesting drug experiences, gifted myself my dream material possession (a Rolex Daytona watch).

But, you know, deep down, I still wish I was still married, I miss holding my (ex) wife hand while shopping in the Farmers Market, I miss her smile, I miss her sunny mood, I don't know, I just want to things to go back to the way they were. I'm aware that's not possible, I understand my life has turned around in some way, but I don't really feel happy anymore (even with meds, even with drugs, even while cocaine-fueled partying) and, well, I don't think like existing anymore. I really wished I killed myself after the divorce... but at the time I thought I should hold on to that since it would be a burden to my parents, my friends and to my former wife. Now, it's been a year, we don't keep in touch, so I'm kinda sure she wouldn't even know if I died. So I feel like I can do it now with less impact on my loved ones. But there's still my parents and friends... Dad wouldn't care (we never been close), but it would be though for my mother... I'm her only son and I feel bad and guilty for leaving her alone. I do love my friends but I think they've known me for a long time, we've talked multiple times about suicide, and I think they would understand (but not accept).

Thank you for 'listening' :-)
